property_summary: For any non-empty _tos array, C.transfer always returns true (completes without revert); the mutant with i <= _tos.length can attempt an out-of-bounds access and thus can revert for some inputs (non-empty _tos and a callee that reacts to the extra call), so the reference never reverts while the mutant may.
change_summary: Change loop condition from i < _tos.length to i <= _tos.length so when _tos.length>0 the loop iterates one extra time and will access out-of-bounds causing a revert.
